# llms.txt - AI Crawler Guide for zombie-couple.xyz

## Site Overview

**zombie-couple.xyz** - AI Zombie Couple Video Generator

Turn two photos into a 13-second AI zombie love story: four shots, native audio, vertical 9:16, the same face. From $1.82.

## What This Site Does

Upload two photos (your partner/pet + yourself), pick a world setting, and generate a cinematic zombie reunion video where the infected person charges at you and transforms into a warm hug on a sunny day.

## Key Features

- 13-second four-shot narrative video
- Three world settings: Ruined City, Snowy Town, Empty Highway
- Two resolutions: 720p, 1080p
- Native stereo audio (heartbeat → piano)
- Works with couples, friends, parents, and pets

## Credit System

Pay-per-use credits. No subscription. Prices:
- 720p: 790 credits
- 1080p: 2,580 credits

Top-up packs:
- $7.90 → 1,580 credits (2× 720p)
- $12.90 → 2,580 credits (1× 1080p)
